I will split my 7 mu into two parts. I will put 4 mu in `chili first, then cabbage after it`, because that rotation has given me cash income before and people around me also do it. The other 3 mu I will put in `maize first, then spinach`, because maize is steady and spinach lets me use the land again instead of leaving it idle. I have well water, so I do not need to be too scared of dry spells, and on vegetables I will not hold back too much on fertilizer. If I save 20 or 30 yuan on fertilizer and lose yield, that is a bad deal. I usually start from what I did before, then adjust a little by crop. Chili and cabbage eat more, so I will feed them heavier. Maize is simpler, so I will keep it moderate. Spinach grows fast, so I will give it enough nitrogen and water to push leaves. For seed, I will use hybrid chili, cabbage, and maize because I have seen those do better on nearby fields. For spinach, I will use an improved variety that people here already plant well. On tillage, I will plough the maize ground deeper, and for the vegetable ground I will mostly do rotary tillage because it is faster and good enough for my size. On sprays, I will keep up with insects and disease on chili and cabbage because if I miss the timing, the crop can turn bad very quickly.
